scope: Actual local UI illustrations from three passing phase 3 browser workflows, not deployment or artist/device qualification
procedure: Temporary browser contexts; real UI tool/menu/drag/undo/preview actions. Screenshots copied unchanged from tests. FREE shows a three-pixel mirrored stroke; ON shows the retained projected stroke; Live Preview shows an outline sketched through one Pen stroke.
review: All three screenshots inspected at full resolution. ON/FREE labels and the single Live Preview are visible. No generated art or image editing used.
